packageRules.description: chromedp and cdproto are a matched pair: cdproto is generated per chromedp release, and bumping either alone does not compile. Move them together.
chromedp 0.15+ replaced the Action API (generic chromedp.Action[T], no ActionFunc/ByQuery); internal/browser and cmd/ need porting first. Hold on the 0.14 line until that port is done.
cdproto must match the pinned chromedp; never take a bare digest or newer tag on its own.
